none: PAS NLM-001206: Roman Coin: Nummus of Valentinian I
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Valentinian I (364-375), Victory left issue, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust diademed, possibly cuirassed, right. Obverse inscription: VALENT[--]. Reverse description: Victory advancing left holding wreath. Reverse inscription: SECVRITAS [REI PVBLICAE]. In exergue: V[--]. Diameter: 17.6mm, Weight: 1.70gms, die axis: 6
